system.description:
You prepare unguents to be applied to weapons or bodies. Crafting them a Spellcast Roll (10) as a Downtime action, which consumes 2 Handfuls and remains potent for a week unless otherwise specified.

  • Revenant Venom. Coat a weapon with this slick, grey fluid. Attacks with this weapon render supernatural creatures temporarily Vulnerable. The venom’s potency lasts until the weapon’s wielder rolls with Fear as part of an attack.
  • Scourgebane. Horrors struck by this herbal resin must mark twice the usual Stress cost to use their abilities.
  • Tears of the Prophet. Anoint a corpse with this sacred oil. That body can no longer be raised or used by dark forces.
